column1: # Executed-oracle ground truth for the wifi_distance contract.
# GENERATED by `cargo xtask oracle-differential`; do not hand-edit.
# Produced by executing the IMMUTABLE v0.3.0 native oracle
# (oracle/libbleradar_core.so) under qemu-aarch64 against a real Android
# Bionic runtime. wifi_distance was previously unmapped in the reconstruction;
# it is reconstructed faithfully here (decision #76) and this differential
# the executed oracle across its whole i32 domain -- the rssi>=0 far-clamp
# sentinel, the plausible-frequency window (2000..=7199 MHz) with a 2437 MHz
# (channel 6) default outside it, the log-distance formula, and the [0.1, 400] m
# clamps. The formula step uses transcendental libm (log10/powf), which is not
# guaranteed bit-identical across host libm versions, so the contract is
# retained as SourceAnalog (matched to <1e-12 relative; observed max 2e-15).
#   WD  <rssi i32>  <frequency_mhz i32>  <code>  <f64 bits>   wifi_distance(rssi, frequency_mhz) -> f64 metres
